subject: Recent changes made to the package?

messages.author: 8fcccdcf9f30e232
messages.subject: Recent changes made to the package?
parts: I went in to change an x-axis for publication purposes on an old figure, and, using the same R script and same input file, I was given a very different figure. Could there be any explanation for this? In other words, have there been changes to this package or even R since June of 2014 that would cause this?

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: Re: Recent changes made to the package?
parts:
I would say it's much more likely that you processed your data in
some subtly different way (sorry).

Do you know what versions of ggplot2 and R you were using in your
previous version?

ggplot2 version 1.0.0 was published in May 2014 (see
http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ggplot2/index.html) so *if* you
were up to date at that time, you're still using the same version.

You can look at ggplot changes at
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/blob/master/NEWS
